excerpt: Export WordPress to a fast static site on Cloudflare Pages in one click — pure PHP, forms and WooCommerce keep working. Plus a free theme and AI content pipeline.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is Pinery Static?

It exports your WordPress site to plain HTML and deploys it to Cloudflare Pages' global CDN — pure PHP, no command line needed. Dynamic features (comments, search, contact forms, WooCommerce prices) keep working by quietly proxying back to your WordPress. Your site gets faster, safer and free to host, while you keep editing in WordPress as always.

Does Pinery Static work together with Flow?

They're built as a pair. Flow writes and publishes affiliate content into WordPress; Static ships the result to the edge. With auto-deploy enabled, every Flow publish re-exports just the changed pages automatically.

Frequently Asked Questions

How is this different from a regular WordPress theme?

Pinery is a two‑part system — a theme for the frontend and a plugin for the backend pipeline. The plugin scrapes Amazon, generates AI images, writes copy, and publishes automatically. The theme displays everything beautifully. It's an end‑to‑end affiliate site factory, not just a skin.

Can I use Pinery for non‑Amazon affiliate programs?

The affiliate metadata field accepts any URL. Pinery displays whatever link you provide. The theme is content‑agnostic — it works as a regular blog, a photography portfolio, or a link‑share site. Only the automated pipeline is Amazon‑specific.

Frequently Asked Questions

Do I need the Amazon API to use Pinery Flow?

No, you can start with HTML scraping right away — no API credentials needed. Once you reach 10 qualifying sales in a 30‑day window, Amazon activates your Creators API access. Enable it in settings and Pinery switches automatically. The API path is more compliant and enables real‑time price updates.

What AI providers does the pipeline support?

xAI (Grok), OpenAI (GPT + DALL·E), and Google Gemini. You choose the provider in settings. Each has its own image‑generation mode: xAI uses text2img, OpenAI uses DALL·E 2 image edits, Gemini uses Imagen.

Is the theme compatible with SEO plugins like Rank Math or Yoast?

Yes — and it auto‑detects them. When an SEO plugin is active, Pinery Flow disables its built‑in meta tags to avoid duplicates. It also fills Rank Math fields (title, description, focus keyword) automatically from the AI‑generated copy.

How many sites does one Flow license cover?

One license = one WordPress site. Need more? Purchase additional licenses at checkout. Every license includes lifetime updates and priority support for that site. The free theme has no site limits.

Will the plugin slow down my site?

All heavy lifting happens during the pipeline run — scraping, image generation, AI copywriting — and is triggered by WP‑Cron or a manual button click. The frontend loads only static HTML, CSS, and a tiny JavaScript bundle (~3 KB). There's zero overhead for your visitors.

Start free. Upgrade when you scale.

Every product has a free plan. Paid licenses are one-time and per site — no subscriptions.

Common questions about Pinery

Pinery Static

What is Pinery Static?

It exports your WordPress site to plain HTML and deploys it to Cloudflare Pages' global CDN — pure PHP, no command line needed. Dynamic features (comments, search, contact forms, WooCommerce prices) keep working by quietly proxying back to your WordPress. Your site gets faster, safer and free to host, while you keep editing in WordPress as always.

Does Pinery Static work together with Flow?

They're built as a pair. Flow writes and publishes affiliate content into WordPress; Static ships the result to the edge. With auto-deploy enabled, every Flow publish re-exports just the changed pages automatically.

Pinery Theme

How is this different from a regular WordPress theme?

Pinery is a two‑part system — a theme for the frontend and a plugin for the backend pipeline. The plugin scrapes Amazon, generates AI images, writes copy, and publishes automatically. The theme displays everything beautifully. It's an end‑to‑end affiliate site factory, not just a skin.

Can I use Pinery for non‑Amazon affiliate programs?

The affiliate metadata field accepts any URL. Pinery displays whatever link you provide. The theme is content‑agnostic — it works as a regular blog, a photography portfolio, or a link‑share site. Only the automated pipeline is Amazon‑specific.

Pinery Flow

Do I need the Amazon API to use Pinery Flow?

No, you can start with HTML scraping right away — no API credentials needed. Once you reach 10 qualifying sales in a 30‑day window, Amazon activates your Creators API access. Enable it in settings and Pinery switches automatically. The API path is more compliant and enables real‑time price updates.

What AI providers does the pipeline support?

xAI (Grok), OpenAI (GPT + DALL·E), and Google Gemini. You choose the provider in settings. Each has its own image‑generation mode: xAI uses text2img, OpenAI uses DALL·E 2 image edits, Gemini uses Imagen.

Is the theme compatible with SEO plugins like Rank Math or Yoast?

Yes — and it auto‑detects them. When an SEO plugin is active, Pinery Flow disables its built‑in meta tags to avoid duplicates. It also fills Rank Math fields (title, description, focus keyword) automatically from the AI‑generated copy.

How many sites does one Flow license cover?

Will the plugin slow down my site?

All heavy lifting happens during the pipeline run — scraping, image generation, AI copywriting — and is triggered by WP‑Cron or a manual button click. The frontend loads only static HTML, CSS, and a tiny JavaScript bundle (~3 KB). There's zero overhead for your visitors.
